title: Fake Customer Care Call (UPI / Bank)
description: Scammers pose as bank/UPI app support and ask for OTP, UPI PIN, or to install a remote-access app.

title: UPI Collect Request / QR Scan Trap
description: You receive a collect request or are asked to scan a QR code to 'receive' money; approving it debits your account.

title: KYC Update Link / Phishing SMS
description: A message claims your KYC will be blocked unless you click a link and enter banking details.

title: Part-time Job / Task Scam (Telegram/WhatsApp)
description: You are promised easy earnings for liking videos or completing tasks; then asked to pay to withdraw money.
